title: Amelia evaluated at the Treffert Center

tellings.quote: you know the the tord center there you know because that's where darl trefford

plain: A researcher named Diane Powell, speaking in 2025 on Jesse Michels's podcast in an episode about children said to read minds, mentions a young person named Amelia. She says Amelia was evaluated in the 2020s at the Treffert Center in Wisconsin, a place tied to Darold Treffert, a man known for studying people with extraordinary abilities. The point of telling it is that a serious centre looked at Amelia's reported gifts.
